description: Topographie du réseau cycliste La Louvière is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de La Louvière. Visualisation des différents types de voiries cyclistes. Coverage: La Louvière. The portal files it under Mobilité, Urbanisme, Patrimoine. Its keywords are vélo, topographie, réseau, statique, mode, doux. The portal shows 547 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-01-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
